Own internal and external communication within pre-defined SLAs Identify risks, potential issues, plan to and mitigate them, and escalate to the Program Leader as appropriate Define and delegate admin work to PCs Control budgets effectively Effectively balance and manage priorities across a variety of task types and customers Establishes deadlines /ensures deadlines are feasible and completes tasks by said deadlines Mitigates risk and escalates issues or problems in an effective manner, along with proposed solutions Asks pertinent questions to ensure full comprehension of the task in hand Strictly follows Production SOPs and best practices. Ensure projects are managed and delivered in line with Production KPIs (Margin, Quality, On Time Delivery) Meticulous attention to detail and the ability to juggle multiple high-priority deadlines. Implement new features, efficiencies and initiatives in line with Department and Company goals. Demonstrated experience working with AI agents, i.e. using agentic tools in daily workflows, prompting/configuring them for tasks, or having built simple agents/automations yourself Able to quickly learn and adopt new AI-powered tools and workflows as part of day-to-day production work DUTIES : Manage the end to end project management workflow (including Translation, QA, DTP, Linguistic Sign Off, E-Learning, Multimedia) Ensure all projects are delivered on time as per customer SLA Manage quality at the project level, ensuring linguists adhere to Customer linguistic assets and QA rules Responds quickly and efficiently to internal and external stakeholders Ensure all system admin, including data entry, is accurate Process invoicing and payments Perform file analysis Monitor linguistic assets (TM, Style Guides, reference material) Demonstrates a deep understanding of all production workflows and processes related to Enterprise accounts Utilize systems and tools released by Production Train supporting resources on key production processes and methodology Develop and maintain process documentation related to their Customer Consistently follow correct protocols for tasks and accounts. Escalate quality complaints and feedback received from Customer stakeholders Raise Customer Support tickets as required Perform Linguist Sourcing in our existing vendor database and enters sourcing requests when new vendors are needed Completes ongoing risk assessment and mitigation for all production areas. Manage linguist communication for all projects PREFERRED EDUCATION : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Languages, Translation, Linguistics REQUIRED EXPERIENCE : 2-5+ years of professional experience in managing large-scale complex production for Life Sciences customers Proven customer-facing experience Excellent internal communication skills, including fast responsiveness and quick resolution Solid organizational skills including meticulous attention to detail and multitasking skills Able to meet deadlines and work under pressure AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.
